fundamentals.name: Astera Labs, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Astera Labs, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells semiconductor-based connectivity solutions for cloud and AI infrastructure in Taiwan and the United States. It offers an intelligent connectivity platform, comprised of semiconductor-based, high-speed, mixed-signal connectivity products that integrate a matrix of microcontrollers and sensors, and COSMOS. The company provides COSMOS software suite, a connectivity system management and optimization software that enables management and optimization of resources for large fleets at cloud-scale via link, fleet, and RAS management capabilities. In addition, it offers PCIe/CXL smart DSP retimers and cable modules; ethernet smart cable modules for cloud and AI infrastructure; CXL memory connectivity controllers; and smart fabric switches. The company serves hyperscalers and system original equipment manufacturers. Astera Labs, Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in San Jose, California.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing semiconductor company with strong margins and a high valuation, supported by significant analyst optimism.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 13.5% (EPS 0.61 vs 0.54); next earnings date is 2026-08-04.
positives: Revenue growth 93.4% YoY, with strong analyst estimates for current Q (57.0%) and FY (63.2%).
Exceptional earnings growth of 144.4% YoY and quarterly earnings growth of 152.4%.
High gross margin (76.0%) and operating margin (20.1%) indicate efficient operations.
Strong return on equity (21.1%) and return on assets (10.1%) demonstrate effective capital utilization.
Healthy liquidity with a current ratio of 11.30 and quick ratio of 10.55.
negatives: Extremely high trailing P/E of 220.17 and forward P/E of 76.94 suggest a very high valuation.
Price/Sales (TTM) of 55.40 and Price/Book of 37.11 also indicate a premium valuation.
Debt/Equity ratio of 2.80 is relatively high, though offset by strong liquidity.
Analyst mean target ($244.97) is below the current spot price ($323.65), indicating potential overvaluation.
High beta of 3.96 suggests significant volatility relative to the market.

news.paragraph: Astera Labs has seen significant upward momentum, with shares soaring over 200% in three months and up 70% since its last earnings report. Recent analyst commentary highlights a product portfolio ramp-up, contributing to a strong growth profile. Despite the impressive run, questions remain about sustainability, especially given the high valuation and beta.
